name: Ruben R. Electrical Services & Handyman
own_site_check_result: No public domain found after extensive web search (WebSearch/WebFetch across Google, Bing text results, Sunbiz, Yelp, Facebook, Angi, HomeAdvisor, Thumbtack). The business's only public ad is on Craigslist (miami.craigslist.org, posted under the 'Hollywood' sub-area). Its Google Business Profile's website field points to that exact Craigslist ad (confirmed live via scripts/maps_research.py, which captured website: 'http://miami.craigslist.org/brw/sks/d/hollywood-ruben-electrical-services/7932093287.html'), not an owned domain. The script's own is_own_website() heuristic flagged this as true only because craigslist.org is not in its PROFILE_HOSTS allowlist; per PIPELINE.md a classifieds ad is explicitly not an owned website, so has_own_site is correctly recorded as false here.

craigslist_ad.geo_subarea: Hollywood (confirmed by the ad's own URL slug 'hollywood-ruben-electrical-services' and by its listing under craigslist's Hollywood/Broward skilled-trade-services search results)
craigslist_ad.body_excerpt: RUBEN - ELECTRICAL & HOME MAINTENANCE SERVICES. Retired Military - Experienced Electrician & Maintenance Technician. Serving Dade & Broward - 7 Days a Week. English & Spanish / Ingles y Espanol. Calls/Texts: 8am-6pm Only.

craigslist_ad.no_photos_in_ad: The Craigslist ad itself is text-only; it contains zero embedded photos (verified by inspecting the raw ad HTML for /gallery markup). All real photos used on this site came from the Google Business Profile instead, via scripts/maps_research.py.

location_verification.result: CONFIRMED: Hollywood, FL is used as the site's primary city.
evidence: The business's only public ad (Craigslist) is geo-tagged 'hollywood' in its own URL slug: hollywood-ruben-electrical-services.
A live scripts/maps_research.py run against the exact Google Business Profile returned the website field as that same Craigslist ad URL, confirming it is the business's own listing (not a lookalike).

The Craigslist ad text states the business serves 'Dade & Broward' generally (no single city named in the ad body); Hollywood, FL sits inside Broward County and is one of Merktop's target zones, matching the task brief.
Pembroke Pines and Miramar (also Broward cities, adjacent to Hollywood) are kept in the site as service-area copy, consistent with the brief's note that the owner also serves those areas.

rating_source: Live Google Business Profile data captured with scripts/maps_research.py (Playwright/Chrome against google.com/maps), which returned rating 5.0 and reviews 34, exactly matching the numbers given in the task brief. No independent secondary source (Yelp/Facebook/Angi) was found for this business; none appear to exist.

hours.source: Live Google Business Profile hours, captured with scripts/maps_research.py. The Craigslist ad separately states 'Calls/Texts: 8am-6pm Only, 7 Days a Week', which is used as supporting trust copy ('7 days a week') on the site without contradicting the more precise per-day GBP hours.

language_evidence: The Craigslist ad body is written almost entirely in English, with one line noting 'English & Spanish / Ingles y Espanol' as a service offered. All 3 real Google review quotes captured live are written in English (Jaime Garcia, John Medina, Ashley). Per PIPELINE.md's rule to verify before assuming 'es' from the owner's name, the evidence points to English as the primary operating language, with Spanish kept as a true bilingual-service trust badge and full ES translation via the site's data-es/data-en toggle.

template_base: templates/dark/index.html (Mizu dark/gold example), re-themed as a dark + champagne-gold 'electrician' palette using the same CSS variable names
build_variant: Adapted variant per PIPELINE.md Fase 3 point 5: no exact pricing (quoted per job, call or text), no map (no published street address, real jobsite photo used instead in Contact), phone/text-based CTA throughout (no online booking), full bilingual EN/ES toggle (English set as default/primary language per research), JSON-LD type Electrician.
research_tooling_note: Initial research relied on WebSearch/WebFetch (Craigslist ad text, Google share-link redirect confirming the Google Business Profile entity) since those tools cannot render Google Maps' JS app. scripts/maps_research.py (Playwright + local Chrome) was then run once against this exact business name/city to pull live, verifiable rating, review count, hours, website field and real photos directly from the Google Business Profile, matching the precedent set by output/a-local-handyman-and-home-services-llc (data/processed.json) which used the same script and failed only because that business genuinely had 0 GBP photos; this business had 11.
notes: No public email found anywhere (Craigslist ad, Google Business Profile, no Facebook/Yelp/Instagram/Angi presence located). Outreach is pending_manual via phone call/text, the real channel stated in the business's own ad ('Calls/Texts: 8am-6pm Only').
